meta.title: Auto Router
meta.description: Registers the virtual model bailian-auto (display name Auto Router). One key, many models: a decision model analyzes modality and task type, then routes to the best execution model under the same account; supports Bailian / SiliconFlow / OpenRouter / Volcengine / Zhipu / Moonshot / DeepSeek and any OpenAI-compatible vendor, with quota-aware cooldowns and silent fallback; mobile falls back to data URIs when fs is unavailable.
